name: ryu.browser
description: A real-Chromium browser (Electron) Ryu runs as a local sidecar and exposes as the grant-gated `browser.control` capability: control tabs, capture screenshots and accessibility snapshots, inspect DOM context, attach frozen-frame annotations, and drive pages with element or coordinate mouse/keyboard input. Core spawns the sidecar lazily and idle-stops it; the desktop Browser panel drives it through the ext-proxy.
